text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Yaeno! You return quite late.
At this rate, our usual "thing" will—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I am going to sleep now.
An important race is fast approaching, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"My time just keeps getting worse...
No matter what, I have to... cut it... down..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Wha! My tracksuit... is gone!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nuwaaaah!?!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I-I washed it by mistake thinking it was mine!!
S-Sorry!! It should be dry by evening, though...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
! ...No, I should be the one apologizing.
I've been so busy that I just left everything in a mess.
...By this evening, correct?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Until the evening... Without my jersey, I can't even train...
That said, how should I pass the time—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why not go to karaoke?
The whole class together! It's on me to apologize!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That song just now... was really nice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ehehe, it's that thing trending lately~
I can send you the link if you want~?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please. This tempo seems like
it would be just right for when I'm running.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Just how obsessed with training are you, girl?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, isn't that...!
Isn't that a "Mononofu Cat" plushie!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah~. That thing where they turned warlords into cats?
That mascot's super popular, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fluffy... cat...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Alright! Yaeno!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, Yaeno!
Use the crane arm to grab it by the neck!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Take aim—right here...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Good grief...
To think my coin would run out first, of all things.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...No, let's do it one more time.
Ending things like this just isn't—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —However... it's already evening.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...!
My jersey should be about dry by now.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, another day, then! Haste makes waste.
With this overworked right hand of mine, I couldn't grab anything even if I tried.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Yaeno, let us play again!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... ...My time is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yaeno!
What about your training?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, it turned out to be a good result.
I have decided to take the day off. And—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't even been able to do 'this'
before going to bed lately, after all."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm—splendid, simply splendid.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: A cup of cola, and the dance of Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It looks like I'll be having pleasant dreams tonight.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gahahahaha, good morning, Trainer!
Man, what a glorious morning it is~♪
choice_data_list: Huh, you look like you're in high spirits.
Huh, you seem to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Truth be told, my pre-bedtime routine was in grave peril, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my brilliant wit, I managed to evade it!
Now I won't have any trouble falling asleep for a while♪
choice_data_list: Alright, then I can train you with everything I've got!
Alright, then we can train you at full power!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my brilliant wit, I managed to evade it!
Now I won't have any trouble falling asleep for a while♪
choice_data_list: Alright, then I can train you with everything I've got!
Alright, then we can train you at full power!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
!? T-Trainer?
What is that fearless smirk for!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whyyy?!
There's way more training than usual today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Despite saying so,
No Reason went on running energetically."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I massaged her tense shoulders for her.
They were terribly stiff, after all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Well, it simply means my brilliant mind has shone once again!
